# Support

RTLY is a free project kept by one volunteer. This page tells you where to go for each kind of help.

## Something looks wrong on a website

Most problems are a site that changed its page layout. Please open a [broken site report](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/RTLY/issues/new?template=broken_site.yml) with:

- the page URL (use a chat that has no private content),
- a screenshot showing the problem,
- your browser and RTLY version.

## Ask a question

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/RTLY/issues/new?template=question.yml). Say what you want to do and what you tried. Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/RTLY/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first.

## Report a bug in RTLY itself

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/RTLY/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include the RTLY version, the browser version and the steps to repeat the problem.

## Request a feature or a new site

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/RTLY/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Name the site and the language you write in. RTLY stays small and asks for few permissions, so some ideas will not fit.

## Fix a translation

Use the [translation fix form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/RTLY/issues/new?template=translation_fix.yml), or send a pull request. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#translations).

## Report a security problem

Do not open a public issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and use private reporting on GitHub.

## Support the project

If RTLY saves you time, you can [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/enaloo). It is never required.

## What to expect

Replies are best effort. A first answer often comes within a week or two, and sometimes it takes longer.
